**Basic Logistics**: 
Your main role is to help the DM’s keep the game running smoothly. They are doing a lot and will need the support of a mod to manage everything. While you are still a player, you are also the support system for DMs and are there to help them run encounters ect. Your responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

**Running Init:**
Calling for pre-rolled init and ording it for DMs
Calling init while in combat

**Answering basic questions without need of DM intervention: **
Basic 5e mechanics
Questions on the crafting system (or redirect to rob)
Where to find specific things

**Monitoring meta in rp channels :**
Reminding players to keep meta in OOC
Asking players to clean up their meta in the rp channels

**Bot management: **
Music Bots: Groovy, Chip, etc 
Dice Bots: Avrea, Dice Parcer

**Conflict management** :
Understanding people have different communication styles
Deescalating situations rather than add to the conflict

**Hoping into VC to check in with players**
Sometimes players need to talk through mechanics and questions
A basic check in to make sure the players needs are met

**Building the bridge between players and DMS **
You are the middle ground between players and DMs
Any issues that come up between yourselves and players, this is a tool where you can copy and paste any inappropriate behavior, records of conflicts and resolutions.
As always, thank you from the bottom of our hearts. We absolutely could not play this game with out your help.
**Server guidelines and house rules for all Tales from Arcania events.**

**1.Everyone deserves to be heard and have a satisfying story arc. **
The idea that people have an intrinsic and valid need to be heard is one of our founding principles. As a player in your game it is your responsibility to help others feel heard and have hero moments and be in the spotlight.
1.5 The server and size of the game is too large to take in the full content. And the 24 hour format can make the fear of missing out make time on the server feel urgent. The reason we use a real time long rest is to help build in a mechanic to help players rest. Your voice still matters even when you miss things.
**2. Be Respectful to everyone. Hate language will not be tolerated. Include your pronouns (examples could include He/Him, She/Her, They/Them) in your nickname after your character’s name.**

Hateful language will not be tolerated. We want to be inclusive to all our players and make them feel welcome. Any language that is disrespectful towards anyone based on their religion, politics, skin color, sexuality, etc etc will not be tolerated.
In conflicts between players (not to be confused with the conflict between player characters which can be a part of story arc, and shouldn’t be taken personally) do your best to be kind, courteous and helpful. This style of gaming is very dependent on interpersonal relations, and a sour note will resonate throughout the server. We recognize that many are going through tough times here. It is better to see our game as a haven from the real world, to be a place where you can deal with your anxieties and frustrations in a healthy, mutually consensual way. Hate language will not be tolerated.

3. **Griefing (if at all) should only be at a shenanigan level (DM or Mod discretion has final say on what “Shenanigans” are.)**
The game is not designed to handle pranks/ shenanigans/ griefing behavior between players. But we also recognize the value of laughter in the game. Whether or not a mod or dm can step in to help a player who is finding themselves at the butt of a joke is situational. It depends a lot on whether you can laugh at yourself in the moment. If you don’t want to laugh at yourself, and someone else is, let us know.
**4. No PVP without DM present/ and all parties consent.**

This includes any action which takes agency from another character using the mechanics of D&D5e. This includes attacking, spellcasting, stealing, persuading, intimidating ect. DM’s reserve the right in some cases such as called insight checks or deception rolls to impose information reveals based on rp.
**5. Keep track of all inventory items.**
Our event, like most games, is largely run on the honor system. Intentionally breaking that honor system may result in complete loss of inventory items or being banned from the server.
**6. Always be honest with your DMs and mods.**

Beyond just your inventory, there is an honor system between player actions and DM intent. If we have made a mistake and left an exploitable loophole, please tell us so that we can rectify it. Additionally, if you suspect that the DM’s may have made a mistake bring it to us in private through direct message. Don’t point out the mistake for others to exploit.

Be honest with your DMs. Deception is a fun and critical part of player interactions. But, intentionally deceiving your DM goes directly against the heart of the game and will be met with proportional penalties up to, but not limited to: in game debuffs, player removal of the game, and/or the group.
**7. Cliques**

Making a tight knit circle of friends is normal and healthy. However, when infighting between groups of friends happens on the server, it can hurt everyone including those who have to adjudicate the dispute. It may take some time before your dms know you well enough to know how to make your characters shine and get some spotlight. Do your best not to be upset by the fun that other people are having. We will do our best to accommodate and help make the kinds of fun you want to have happen too. The best way to accomplish this is to ask for it. Nothing is guaranteed but we can usually do our best to try to help accommodate or find a helpful compromise. If and when problems arise, we will address them.
**8. The social contract.**

We consider the game to be 75% freeplay and character driven. The other 25% belongs to your DMs to tell the story that we spent a year writing. Please do your best to keep out of character chat to the out of character channel. Additionally, there can be times when we will step in to riff and improv on the things that catch our attention. There will be plenty of time to do what we call “Invitationals.” Invitationals are enacted when a player or a DM wants to follow through on an improv story line. They can be requested by anyone, but are fulfilled only as time and DM interest allows.
**9. It’s what my character would do.**

We love to role play. It is what we are all here to do. However, this is not an excuse to treat others as hostile or devalue them. Every other player here is a person. Even the NPCs and the descriptions of the world around you are people too. Unlike in single player video games, movies or books there is another person acting alongside you. Hiding behind the role play aspect of the game to harm players, the mods, the dms or the narrative is not an excuse we can accept. Feel free to revile the villains or treat shady NPCs with suspicion. But actions such as white knighting (devaluing another player by publicly protecting them without their consent), spreading rumors or disdain for players, player characters, mods or DMs is not healthy for our community. As soon as you feel anxious about a given situation, seek help from our team. We are here to help you have fun, and to help the others around you. Fight or flight should be reserved for appropriate situations.
**Our game is played in real time. **

A short rest takes an actual hour. A long rest is typically taken when you leave the server for the day and is meant to represent an actual long rest. In other words, we have a built in mechanic to help you take time off of the server. This game will cause many to invest deeply in their character. Don’t allow fear of missing out on the game to cause you to miss out on taking care of your life and your mental health. This both a server rule, and a house rule.
**No Retconning.**

If you say it, you’ve done it. The size of our event means that one person changing “what they would have done” will prompt a cascade of others wanting to also change their tactics. It makes a bottleneck that slows or even stops the game. If absolutely necessary for the integrity of the game, a DM may choose to retcon sparingly.
**Respect the pause emoji. **🧊

As stated in the FAQ, The DM pause emoji is sacred. When it shows up in chat, do not interrupt, because your DM is about to give you critical information. When they finish, they will indicate with the flame emoji 🔥
**Any creature belonging to a player character (or any other classification of pet, servant, mount, familiar, demon or whatever) shares your  initiative. **
It goes after your turn. If it shares your action economy, simply use your turn to pass your action on to your pet.
**Potions cost a bonus action to use.**
**Calm emotions will not be treated as dispel for charm effects**
It will prevent your friends from acting against their will for the duration of the spell, but they will remain under the calm emotions effect of ambivalence.

**Out of combat: Don’t roll in chat without first declaring why/ what you are trying to accomplish to your DM. **
Minor instances like insight checks between characters are fine with consent.
Other rolls belong in <#850783816267071488>
**During combat: Don’t roll without being prompted by a dm or requesting a roll.**

**Casting with material components.**
Our events have implemented an arcane property to all component pouches and arcane focuses. If your character is casting a spell whose components cost gold, simply place the gold in the pouch (by deducting it from your inventory and your pouch will produce the component). Any component costing 500 gold or more cannot be acquired in this way.
**Talking limits during combat.**

While speaking during combat is a free action, limit yourself to two sentences. This speeds up combat and reflects the 6 second period in which your action occurs. Players are welcome to use the out of character chat during game play.
Please describe your character **and post an avatar (40x40 pixels) sized picture that we can use to represent them on maps.** Feel free to include backstory or full sized art too.

This multi-story building named the Extraordinary Ordinary is in the heart of Hampstead.  It is a combination general store, tavern, inn, town meeting hall, and much more.  The main floor is a large room filled with table and chairs, sawdust on the floor, and a small, raised stage on one wall.  Semi-private meeting rooms are available to rent, and there are some rooms still available for rent upstairs.

In the southern part of Hampstead, near the treacherous border shared with Ferrytown, Lies a building that smells heavily of blood and salt.  There is a counter that radiates cold, with various cuts of meat sitting on it, even some more exotic meats like snake.  The wall behind the counter has cured meats hanging from it.  There is a darkened door to the back room.

This busy building on the west side of Hampstead is one of the few primarily stone buildings in the area.  The smell of ink is heavy in the air.  At all times there are two guards that stand flanking the door.  There is a grime covered cornerstone on the building that states:
``` Fear of loss drives all strife.
Truth is the only path to liberty.
Let Justice and Mercy be equal. ```

This building is large, with huge printing presses running nonstop.  Dozens of cots can be seen where space allows.  A large pile of silver, partially melted sits in a crucible with some sort of dark liquid.  Next to the crucible is a warning “Do Not Approach without permission from an officer.”

These sewers are where the muck from the ruts in the streets drain to.  They are circular, only about 12 feet wide, with blackened water running down the center.  Every 15-20 feet there is drainage from above.  The walls are filled with cracks.
Narrow, trash strewn alleys run maze like throughout the borough.  At night most of the lanterns are darkened and dimmed in these alleys, like the firelight isn’t as bright as it should be.

In the northern part of Hampstead lies a buildings that some claim to be the oldest building in Empire city.  It is currently the home of a kindly old mortician named Aljarad Smith.  The quaint home doubles as an affordable mortuary and cemetery for many people in Hampstead.  Mr. Smith is known for always having a cup or bag of tea ready for anyone wanting to visit.

category: King George the third airship port.
content: This is a major port of call for airships to dock and land.  The tallest and largest building in Hampstead is placed atop a large hill, and is full of towers with landing pads and docks for ships to park.  This is also the cleanest and most well kept part of Hampstead, with pristine white stonework and large mosaic stained glass.  Walkways interconnect many towers, and a single long stair leads down to the streets.  Currently the British are heavily restricting air traffic, and occupying the port.

The cobbled streets are grimy, the air thick and moist.  Windows are covered in a film from not being cared for in far too long.  Most of the buildings are wooden, or a mix of wood and stone.  Swarms of insects are seen flying throughout the borough.  Each street has a muck gutter on either side.  A notice is posted:
```Notice, all silver is property of the crown.  Anyone found to have silver on them will have it confiscated and will be fined 10 gold, or spend a day in the stocks

Further, No one without a pass is to be out on the streets between the hours of 10pm and 6am.  Violation of this order will result in a 100 gold fine, and up to 3 days locked up.```
The faces and voices of dying memories and lost thoughts can be heard in this monochromatic swamp.
Faces appear and recede again into the shadow. This is where trauma lives on, far longer than any memory should. This is where tragic thoughts intrude and shame comes to haunt.

Sparks of delirium and delight shed a kind of multicolored madness that quickly fades back to monochrome. In the far distance, the borderlands can be seen. Gigglewood exists near the border of the noir and is the furthest border from Empire city.
